description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two methods—Vanilla and SepLLM—used in the context of accelerating large language models through compression. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000, with major gridlines at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis shows the loss value, scaled from 2.40 to 2.75, with gridlines every 0.05 units. The Vanilla method is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, while the SepLLM method is shown with a red line and circle markers. Both lines start at a loss of approximately 2.75 at the beginning of training and decrease rapidly in the initial phase. After about 50,000 seconds, both curves flatten, indicating convergence. The SepLLM method consistently maintains a lower loss than the Vanilla method across the entire training period. A green dashed line highlights a region between 180,000 and 200,000 seconds, where the SepLLM loss is approximately 1.26 times lower than the Vanilla loss, as indicated by the annotation "1.26×".
